what_was_built: A correction of a2-path's 18 matrices, in path order, starting from a2-path's model. Fitted: the contexts of the 12 correct answers a2-path broke, each through the first token a2-path's own answer changes (104 rows), asked for the state they had in the original model; and the same contexts of the 17 wrong answers it repaired (265 rows), asked for the state a2-path's model gives them. All 18 corrections were written. Each is 0.9% to 3.4% of a2-path's change of that matrix.

answers_on_its_own.how: The corrected model answers the 60 questions of the overlap and round one's 28 on its own, greedy, on GPU0. The same judge reads the original, a2-path's and this model's answer.
answers_on_its_own.complete_answers: Complete answers, this run beside a2-path: of the 12 correct answers a2-path broke, 3 (a2-path 0); of the 17 wrong answers it repaired, 10 (17); of the 13 wrong answers it did not repair, 2 (0); of the 18 correct answers it kept, 13 (18). In all 12 of the 30 that were wrong and 16 of the 30 that were correct (a2-path 17 and 18). Round one, outside the fit: 5 of its 21 failures and 2 of its 7 correct answers (a2-path 7 and 3).
answers_on_its_own.the_calculation_the_edit_aimed_at: By the judge's field for the available energy, of the 30 answers that subtracted the descent: still subtracting it 3, leaving it out 1, stating the right available energy 13 (a2-path 1, 3 and 17). Of the 30 that were correct: with the field 'descent subtracted' 3, stating the right energy 17 (a2-path 0 and 18). The field reads the stated number only: under a2-path Astra's reading of the text found four correct answers whose first error was the descent subtracted where the field says 'other' or 'missing', so the field undercounts and the two models are compared on the field alone. These answers have not been read one by one.
answers_on_its_own.texts: 16 of the 60 answers of the overlap are a2-path's answer token for token. 13 leave a2-path's answer within their first 20 steps; the others leave it later. Against a2-path, 15 of the 88 answers went from complete to not complete and 5 the other way.
answers_on_its_own.the_fourth_token: At the fourth token, where every answer still has the original's whole history, this model prefers ' calculation' over ' compact' by 0.26 to 0.48 of a score more than the original (median 0.35); a2-path by 0.24 to 0.45 (median 0.34). The shift is smaller than a2-path's in 29 of the 60 answers and about the same in the four groups (medians 0.34, 0.35, 0.35, 0.35). 42 answers leave the original's text at that token (a2-path 40; 39 of them under both).

own_traces.how: As a2-path: each of the 60 answers of this model recorded with the turns of its own computation, laid on the axis by the computation alone, read against the original correct and wrong patterns as turns and as states. 0 is the wrong pattern, 1 the correct one; sideways and travelled are in gaps.
own_traces.beside_a2_path: Over places 142 to 313 the answers that were wrong lie 0.87 of the way to the correct pattern (states; a2-path 0.79) and 1.44 gaps to the side (1.04); the correct answers travelled 1.42 gaps (1.27); the two groups are 0.54 as far apart as before (0.54). By group, where each answer's own trace lies (median): the 17 repaired 1.0, the 13 not repaired 0.76, the 12 damaged 0.71, the 18 kept 0.89.

construction_readings.note: Readings of the build on the given text, against the state of the same rows in a2-path's model read once before any correction. They are not a test.
construction_readings.what_the_fit_did: On the given text the fit served neither ask: it split by step, not by answer. The damaged answers' rows keep 0.38 to 0.54 of a2-path's action (they end 0.42 to 0.73 as far from their original state as a2-path left them) and the repaired answers' same opening steps keep 0.45 to 0.68; those rows end 0.41 to 0.60 of a2-path's action away from the state a2-path gave them. The repaired answers' later steps (125 rows, of the three answers whose first change comes after step 15) keep 0.99 to 1.00. 'Kept' is the part of the movement along a2-path's action, not how alike the two states are; the distance to a2-path's state is given per matrix by Astra's formula.
construction_readings.distance_to_a2_paths_state: apart_from_a2_paths_state_after_rms = sqrt(apart_from_original_after_rms^2 + a2_paths_action_rms^2 (1 - 2 a2_paths_action_kept_after)), Astra's formula, per set and matrix.

prediction_vs_result.building: As expected in kind, not in degree. Neither ask was met and the correction is a small part of a2-path's change (0.9% to 3.4%). But the rows did not end nearer a2-path's state on both sets: the damaged answers' rows keep more than half of a2-path's action at 3 of the 18 matrices, the repaired answers' opening rows at 15.
prediction_vs_result.fourth_token: Not as predicted. The preference does not move less than under a2-path: median 0.35 against 0.34, smaller in 29 of 60 answers. It is about the same in the damaged and the repaired answers, as predicted, and 39 of the 40 answers that left their text there under a2-path still do.
prediction_vs_result.complete_answers: As predicted. 3 of the 12 damaged answers are complete, fewer than half, and 10 of the 17 repaired stay complete.
prediction_vs_result.the_descent: As predicted on the judge's field: 27 of the 30 answers that were wrong no longer subtract the descent (26 neither subtract nor omit it); the prediction was more than 25.
prediction_vs_result.traces: The answers that were wrong lie 0.87 of the way along the gap over places 142 to 313; the prediction was about a2-path's 0.79.
prediction_vs_result.would_weaken_it: The result that would have weakened the hypothesis did not occur: the traces lie 0.87 along the gap and 27 of 30 do not subtract. The result that would have shown the C rung working as round one's did not occur either: the damaged rows did not return while the repaired kept, and the damaged answers are not correct again. The construction did not collapse to the original model: 0.998 to 1.000 of a2-path's change of each matrix is kept.

failures_only.note: Every answer with its fields in the original model, after a2-path and after this run; its role by a2-path's record; the first step at which it writes another token than the original, under a2-path and under this run, and than a2-path's own answer; its fourth token; and for the 60 of the overlap where its own trace lies between the two patterns over places 142 to 313.

what_this_changes: The C rung as round one built it is not available here. At layers 0 to 8 the contexts through the first changed token are the same inputs for the answers a2-path damaged and the ones it repaired, and a fit asked to cancel on one and keep on the other splits the difference on both. Round one's C had a single matrix at layer 16 and inputs that differed by 4 to 21%.

Taking back about half of a2-path's action on those rows did not move the model's first changed choice at all (the fourth-token preference: median 0.35 against 0.34). c2-protected, which takes back most of it, moves that preference only part of the way back.

A model within 3.4% of a2-path's change of each matrix is not a2-path: 20 of 88 answers changed completeness, 15 lost and 5 gained, and only 16 of 60 texts are the same. With the three fractions of a2-path this is a fourth neighbour of a2-path that completes fewer answers than it in both groups, while the calculation the edit aims at stays repaired in most. The count of complete answers is a fragile measure between neighbouring models; the calculation and the traces are the steadier ones.

The traces of this model's own answers lie further along the gap than a2-path's (0.87 against 0.79 over places 142 to 313) and further to the side (1.44 gaps against 1.04), with fewer answers complete. Two models whose matrices differ by at most 3.4% of a2-path's change differ by 0.08 in that reading, because each writes other texts and each text is laid on the axis by its own computation. A difference of that size between two rungs is within what the texts alone produce.

The conditioning field recorded in this run's build.jsonl (protected_input_outside_the_repaired_answers_span) was computed over all 369 fitted rows by a mistake Astra found, and is not the protected rows' own; c2-protected's build records the right one (median 0.0% to 0.8% per matrix, at most 4.4%).
